title: Mode Dynamics: A Framework for Neural Network Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.40143v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Mode Dynamics, a framework that connects coordinated parameter motion during neural network learning to changes in model outputs. Starting from a recorded parameter trajectory, we decompose its updates into collective modes and map each mode to its state-dependent output effect. The framework organizes this link through three mechanisms. Decomposition identifies collective modes in parameter motion and their time-varying amplitudes. Reconstruction tests whether the effects induced by those modes recover local and accumulated output change. Concentration quantifies how behavioral contribution is distributed across modes. Controlled scalar regression and next-token experiments directly test these mechanisms. They show that small sets of leading modes reconstruct behavior, induced effects depend on the training path, and modal complexity varies with task and data. translated_title: 模式动力学：一个神经网络学习框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了模式动力学，这是一个将神经网络学习过程中参数的协同运动与模型输出变化联系起来的框架。从记录的参数轨迹出发，我们将参数更新分解为集体模式，并将每种模式映射到其依赖于状态的输出效应。该框架通过三种机制来组织这一联系。分解：识别参数运动中的集体模式及其随时间变化的振幅。重构：检验这些模式诱导的效应能否恢复局部和累积的输出变化。集中度：量化行为贡献在各模式之间的分布情况。受控的标量回归和下一词元预测实验直接检验了这些机制。结果表明，少数主导模式即可重构模型行为，诱导效应依赖于训练路径，且模式复杂度随任务和数据而变化。在一个受控的归纳任务中，抑制主导模式……
tldr: 该论文提出“模式动力学”框架，通过分解、重构和集中度三种机制将神经网络训练中参数的集体运动模式与其输出效应联系起来，发现少数主导模式即可重构模型行为，且效应依赖训练路径、模式复杂度随任务和数据变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mode Dynamics, a framework that links coordinated parameter motion during neural network learning to output changes through decomposition, reconstruction, and concentration mechanisms, showing that a small set of leading modes can reconstruct model behavior while modal complexity varies with task and data.
